articles.title: The global memory shortage hits the MacBook Air
articles.description: The global memory chip shortage appears to be affecting the availability of Apple’s most popular Mac.
articles.summary: Apple'in beloved but increasingly scarce and expensive Air laptops are a victim of the global chip shortage.
points: The availability of Apple’s popular MacBook Air is being impacted due to the worldwide memory-chip deficit.

Apple has had to raise prices, as suppliers struggle with high demand and limited production capacity. This follows a global semiconductor crunch that began in late 2021 amid Covid supply chain disruptions which continue today (with no end date), according to the Wall Street Journal.
Apple’s Mac line has been growing steadily since early last year, and now with inventory limited by memory chip shortages suppliers are able to demand higher prices for components.
articles.insight: The global technology industry is experiencing a persistent semiconductor scarcity exacerbated by the Covid-19 pandemic. This has caused significant disruptions in product availability, such as Apple's MacBook Air, leading to increased prices and manufacturer challenges.
